claims: Dusty May is the head coach of the University of Michigan men's basketball team.
Dusty May was hired in March 2024 to lead the University of Michigan men's basketball team.
Dusty May led Florida Atlantic University to the 2023 Final Four.
Dusty May replaced Juwan Howard as head coach of the University of Michigan men's basketball team.
Juwan Howard was fired after the 2023–24 season.
Dusty May is the David and Meredith Kaplan Men's Basketball Head Coach.
Dusty May was head coach at Florida Atlantic from 2018 to 2024.
Dusty May compiled a 126-69 record at Florida Atlantic.
Dusty May was hired on March 27, 2024, to succeed Juwan Howard.
Kim Barnes Arico has been the head coach of the University of Michigan women's basketball program since 2012.
